data.title: 塑心 · 收好的琴弓
data.description: 练习结束，她擦拭琴弓，将它扣回琴盒。确认乐谱也收好后，她才合上盖子。
data.promptProse: In a sunlit rehearsal room, Virtuosa stands over an antique wooden table, meticulously securing a polished wooden cello bow into the plush velvet clips of an open instrument case. Beside the case rest an amber rosin cake, a soft cleaning cloth, and loose manuscript sheets under cool morning window light.
data.animaCaption: She fastens the cello bow into its velvet-lined case compartment, lingering a moment to inspect the tension before closing the brass latches.
